lines.text: The LORD tells Isaiah to write Maher-shalal-hash-baz on a large scroll, with Uriah the priest and Zechariah as witnesses.
Isaiah's son is named Maher-shalal-hash-baz, and before he can cry 'Father,' the king of Assyria will carry off Damascus's wealth.
The LORD says this people rejected the gently flowing waters of Shiloah and rejoiced in Rezin and the son of Remaliah.
The Lord will bring the floodwaters of the Nile, the king of Assyria, which will pour into Moab up to the neck.
The peoples who prepare for battle will be shattered, and their plans will be thwarted, for God is with us.
